name: pronephric duct
definition: Duct of the embryonic kidney, present bilaterally ventral to the somites and leading to the cloacal chamber. Wingert et al. have suggested that the pronephric duct as described traditionally may consist of subregions which are analogous to portions of the tubule segment of mammalian and other fish nephrons.
overrideNote: Handoff pronephros_mesonephros: the pronephric duct, tubule and glomerulus hand off to the kidney over 288 to 336 hpf (D9); the window end equals the ZFA end (Days 7-13). The fade-out spans the window.

events.text: Duct term starts in ZFIN (10-13 somites).
Distal end starts to migrate toward the cloaca (16 to 18 somites).
Distal segment fuses with the cloaca by 22 somites.
Ducts complete along the trunk.
Ducts converge at the cloaca in wt1b reporter larvae.
ZFIN end stage Days 7-13; mesonephric duct continues in the adult.

sizes.note: somite 5 to cloaca; somite length about 45 um

sources: 14 to 21 hpf: the ducts grow caudally from somite 5 (u 0.35) and fuse with the cloaca by the 22-somite stage (Kimmel et al. 1995; research 03d events)
24 hpf: 20 um wide from somite 5 to the cloaca; 48 hpf: 30; 120 hpf: 35; 240 hpf: 40 um (research 03d rows; estimate)

one spline draws both ducts: down the left side (w -0.42), across at the cloaca, back along the right side, so the pair converges at the cloaca (research 03d shape note); ventral to the somites, lateral to the aorta (estimate)
the mesonephric duct continues the same path from 336 hpf (handoff pronephros_mesonephros)

name: kidney
definition: Cavitated compound organ located in the pleuroperitoneal cavity where hematopoiesis and filtering of blood occur.
overrideNote: Handoff pronephros_mesonephros: the kidney is seeded from the pronephric duct at its own ZFA start, 120 hpf (DM-33); the pronephric parts fade out over 288 to 336 hpf (D9). DM-36: axis clamp at 4320 hpf.

events.text: Kidney and nephron progenitor terms start in ZFIN (Day 5).
First mesonephric nephron expresses cdh17 at 5.2 to 5.5 mm (about 10 dpf).
First podocytes and first nephron primordium ventral to the sixth myotome (12 to 14 dpf).
Nephrogenesis proceeds caudally, then rostrally from 18 to 20 dpf.
Head, trunk and tail regions distinct at 9 mm (about 30 dpf).
About 150 medial nephrons (48 percent of the total) by 3 months; number still rises slowly to 18 months.

sizes.note: nephron progenitor clusters only; no organ yet
first mesonephric nephrons around the pronephros
head, trunk and tail regions present at 9 mm

sources: 120 hpf: nephron progenitor clusters, 50 x 20 x 20 um, around the pronephric ducts (Zhou et al. 2010; research 03d row; estimate)
240 to 336 hpf: the first mesonephric nephrons form ventral to the sixth myotome around the pronephric distal segments; 300 x 80 x 50 um at 336 hpf (Diep et al. 2015; research 03d rows; estimate)
the mesh ends at 336 hpf: the posterior kidney (from 336 hpf) and the head kidney draw the organ and the record continues as their parent (research 03d kidney and posterior kidney rows)
Phase 2 visual calibration (RN-07): the kidney is a thin band directly under the vertebral column, above the swim bladder.

name: mesonephric duct
definition: Duct of the adult kidney (mesonephros), present bilaterally ventral to the somites and leading to the cloacal chamber.
overrideNote: DM-19: ZFA start stage Unknown. The mesonephric duct is the pronephric duct that persists after 14 dpf, so it is drawn from 336 hpf, the end of the pronephros_mesonephros window (research 03d). DM-36: axis clamp at 4320 hpf.

events.text: Pronephric duct term ends; mesonephric duct continues.
Drains the adult kidney into the cloacal chamber.

sources: 336 hpf: 1500 x 40 um, the pronephric duct path continued (research 03d row; estimate); adult 12000 x 300 um (research 03d row; estimate)
one spline draws both ducts as a U that meets at the cloaca, the same construction as the pronephric duct (estimate)

name: head kidney
definition: The zebrafish head kidney consists of fused bilateral lobes located in the anterior part of the kidney. It is analogous to the mammalian bone marrow and the primary site of definitive hematopoiesis.
overrideNote: DM-19: ZFA start stage Unknown. Drawn from 96 hpf, when hematopoietic cells are present in the pronephros and kidney hematopoiesis starts (Willett et al. 1999; Murayama et al. 2006; spec 3.5.3). D5: excretory with alsoIn hematopoietic_immune and endocrine. DM-36: axis clamp at 4320 hpf.

events.text: Hematopoietic cells in the pronephros at 96 hpf; the kidney is seeded by hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells from 4 dpf.
events.source: Willett et al. 1999 Dev Dyn 214:323-336 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10213388/; Murayama et al. 2006 Immunity 25:963-975 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17157041/

events.text: Lymphocytes detected in the kidney at 3 weeks.
events.source: Willett et al. 1999 Dev Dyn 214:323-336 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10213388/

events.text: Head, trunk and tail regions distinct at 9 mm.
Main site of definitive hematopoiesis in the adult.

sources: Willett et al. 1999 Dev Dyn 214:323-336 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10213388/
96 to 120 hpf: hematopoietic cells in the anterior pronephros, 80 x 40 x 60 um at 120 hpf (Willett et al. 1999; Murayama et al. 2006; research 03c row; estimate)
720 hpf: head region distinct at 9 mm, 1000 x 500 x 300 um; adult 3000 x 1800 x 900 um reduced to 3000 x 1800 x 900 fused lobes under the spine (research 03d rows; estimate)
u 0.26 behind the pharynx, ventral to the notochord (research 03c and 03d; estimate)
Phase 2 visual calibration (RN-07): the kidney is a thin band directly under the vertebral column, above the swim bladder.

name: posterior kidney
definition: posterior kidney. (ZFA has no definition text for this term; atlas wording.)
overrideNote: ZFA starts the posterior kidney at Day 6 (144 hpf); the first mesonephric nephrons of the trunk appear at 12 to 14 dpf, so the strip is drawn from 336 hpf when the kidney record hands the trunk over (research 03d; Diep et al. 2015). DM-36: axis clamp at 4320 hpf.

events.text: Posterior kidney term starts in ZFIN (Day 6).
First nephron primordium ventral to the sixth myotome.
New nephrons form on top of the pronephric distal segments at the 8 mm stage.
Trunk and tail regions distinct at 9 mm.

sources: 336 hpf: 1500 x 80 x 50 um strip on the pronephric distal segments; 720 hpf: 4000 x 300 x 200 reduced to 2500 x 240 x 120; adult 11000 x 1200 x 600 um reduced to 8000 x 1100 x 500 so the strip stays under the spine (Diep et al. 2015; research 03d rows; estimate)
a flattened ellipsoid under the vertebral column from behind the head kidney to the vent level, u 0.30 to 0.58 (research 03d; estimate)
Phase 2 visual calibration (RN-07): the kidney is a thin band directly under the vertebral column, above the swim bladder.

Phase 2 visual calibration (VR-11, RN-07): the band runs from behind the head kidney to about 0.78 of the axis, past the swim bladder and into the caudal peduncle, instead of stopping at the vent; the ellipsoid tapers to nothing at both ends, so the band thins toward the tail as the adult reference figure draws it.

name: pronephric glomerulus
definition: Paired highly vascularized structures of the pronephros which are fused at the midline. Responsible for blood filtration and begins to function between 40 and 48hpf.
overrideNote: Handoff pronephros_mesonephros: the pronephric glomerulus hands off to the kidney over 288 to 336 hpf (D9); the window end equals the ZFA end (Days 7-13). The fade-out spans the window. ZFIN start 14 hpf marks specification; the model draws the pronephros from 24 hpf when podocyte progenitors and the duct are visible.

events.text: Term starts in ZFIN (10-13 somites).
Podocyte progenitors in a curve at somite 3 to 4.
Filtration begins between 40 and 48 hpf.
Podocyte clusters fused at the midline at somite 3.
ZFIN end stage Days 7-13.

sources: 24 hpf: two 30 um clusters left and right of the midline at somite 3, drawn as one ellipsoid 84 um wide; 48 hpf: fused 70 x 40 x 50 um under the dorsal aorta; 120 hpf: 90 x 50 x 60; 240 hpf: 100 x 60 x 70 um (Drummond et al. 1998; research 03d rows; estimate)
u 0.30 (somite 3), directly ventral to the notochord and dorsal aorta (Wingert et al. 2007; estimate)

name: pronephric tubule
definition: Bilaterally paired tubes connecting the pronephric glomeruli to the pronephric ducts. In zebrafish and other teleosts, the pronephric nephron and tubules form after the pronephric duct, connecting to the anterior-most tip of the pronephric ducts.
overrideNote: Handoff pronephros_mesonephros: the pronephric tubule hands off to the kidney over 288 to 336 hpf (D9); the window end equals the ZFA end (Days 7-13). The fade-out spans the window.

events.text: Term starts in ZFIN (10-13 somites).
Segments patterned; anterior boundary of the proximal tubule at somite 5.
Anterior boundary shifts to somite 3.
Proximal convoluted tubule coils between 72 and 144 hpf.
ZFIN end stage Days 7-13.

sources: 24 hpf: 150 x 25 um; 48 hpf: 200 x 30; 120 hpf: 300 x 35 (coiled, drawn straight); 240 hpf: 350 x 40 um (research 03d rows; estimate)
paired rods from the glomerulus at somite 3 into the anterior tip of each duct, u 0.33, w +-0.4 (Wingert et al. 2007; ZFA definition; estimate)

name: cloaca
definition: Part of the gut where the pronephric tubules come together with the caudal end of the intestine attaching at 4dpf. The oviduct or sperm duct connect later.
overrideNote: D5 places the cloaca in the excretory system (alsoIn digestive); ZFA makes it part of the gut ZFA:0000112, which stays the zfaParent, and the tree groups it under the renal system (review DR-09). DM-36: axis clamp at 4320 hpf.

events.text: Cloaca term starts in ZFIN (Prim-5); pronephric ducts fuse at the cloaca at 24 to 30 hpf.
Hindgut inserts into the cloaca.
Intestine attaches to the cloaca at 4 dpf (ZFA definition).
Cloaca opens for excretion.
Oviduct or sperm duct connect in the adult.

sources: D5 scope table: excretory (pronephros, glomerulus, ducts, cloaca, mesonephros, head kidney)
24 hpf: 25 um; 48 hpf: 35; 120 hpf: 45; adult 800 um reduced to 640 (research 03d rows; estimate); a chamber at the end of the gut spline where the pronephric ducts meet it (ZFA definition)
placed at ventU - 0.006, v -0.7 (body frame; estimate)
